title: Avoid much [negative] assumption
arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اجْتَنِبُوا كَثِيرًا مِّنَ الظَّنِّ إِنَّ بَعْضَ الظَّنِّ إِثْمٌ
latin: Ya ayyuhalladzina amanu ijtanibu kathiran minaz zanni inna ba'daz zanni ithm
translation: O you who have believed, avoid much [negative] assumption. Indeed, some assumption is sin.
lesson: Husnuzan (good assumption) is an act of worship. Protect your heart from assuming the worst about others.
